name: CiApmTrace
description: Sends CI pipeline traces to Elastic APM
author: kester.simm.mockholm@outlook.com
helpMarkDown: Sends CI pipeline traces to Elastic APM. Requires the ELASTIC_APM_SERVER_URL and ELASTIC_APM_SECRET_TOKEN environment variables to be set on the pipeline.

inputs.name: fail
inputs.label: Force pipeline failure
inputs.helpMarkDown: Force the trace to end as a failure

inputs.name: debug
inputs.label: Debug output
inputs.helpMarkDown: Show the APM server response body in the build log

inputs.name: apmServer
inputs.label: APM server URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Elastic APM server URL. Overrides the ELASTIC_APM_SERVER_URL environment variable.

inputs.name: apmToken
inputs.label: APM secret token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Elastic APM secret token. Overrides the ELASTIC_APM_SECRET_TOKEN environment variable.
